name: Viking 1
description: First successful Mars lander. Operated for over 6 years on Chryse Planitia.

name: Viking 2
description: Second Viking lander. Operated for 3+ years on Utopia Planitia.

name: Mars Pathfinder (Sojourner)
description: First Mars rover. Landed in Ares Vallis.

name: Spirit (MER-A)
description: Mars Exploration Rover. Explored Gusev Crater for 6+ years.

name: Opportunity (MER-B)
description: Mars Exploration Rover. Explored Meridiani Planum for 15 years. Traveled 45.16 km.

name: Phoenix
description: Polar lander. Confirmed water ice on Mars.

name: Curiosity (MSL)
description: Mars Science Laboratory rover. Exploring Gale Crater and Mount Sharp.

name: InSight
description: Geophysical lander. Studied Mars interior with seismometer.

name: Perseverance
description: Mars 2020 rover with Ingenuity helicopter. Exploring Jezero Crater for signs of ancient life.

name: Zhurong
description: China's first Mars rover. Explored Utopia Planitia.

name: Beagle 2
description: Lander that reached the surface but failed to fully deploy its solar panels. Located by MRO in 2015.

name: Schiaparelli EDM
description: ExoMars test lander. Crashed due to premature parachute release.

name: Apollo 11
description: First crewed Moon landing. Sea of Tranquility.

name: Apollo 12
description: Precision landing near Surveyor 3. Ocean of Storms.

name: Apollo 14
description: Fra Mauro formation.

name: Apollo 15
description: Hadley Rille. First use of Lunar Roving Vehicle.

name: Apollo 16
description: Descartes Highlands.

name: Apollo 17
description: Taurus-Littrow valley. Last crewed Moon mission.

name: Chang'e 3 (Yutu)
description: First soft landing on Moon since 1976.

name: Chang'e 4 (Yutu-2)
description: First landing on far side of Moon. Von Karman crater.

name: Chang'e 5
description: Sample return mission. Mons Rumker, Oceanus Procellarum.

name: Chandrayaan-3 (Vikram)
description: First landing near lunar south pole.

name: SLIM
description: Smart Lander for Investigating Moon. Precision landing near Shioli crater.

name: IM-1 Odysseus
description: Intuitive Machines Nova-C lander. First commercial soft landing on the Moon near Malapert A.

name: Chang'e 6
description: First successful sample return mission from the lunar far side (Apollo basin, South Pole-Aitken).

name: Surveyor 1
description: First US soft landing on the Moon. Ocean of Storms.

name: Surveyor 3
description: Ocean of Storms. Later visited by the Apollo 12 astronauts.

name: Luna 9
description: First spacecraft to achieve a soft landing on the Moon. Oceanus Procellarum.

name: Luna 16
description: First robotic sample return mission from the Moon. Mare Fecunditatis.

name: Luna 24
description: Last Soviet lunar sample return mission. Mare Crisium.

name: Artemis III: Peak Near Shackleton
description: Artemis III Candidate Landing Region (NASA 2022 list). Prime South Pole ridge with up to 86% annual sunlight and continuous Direct-to-Earth communication.

name: Artemis III: Connecting Ridge
description: Artemis III Candidate Landing Region (NASA 2022 list). High ground connecting Shackleton and de Gerlache with high illumination and gentle rover slopes.

name: Artemis III: Connecting Ridge Extension
description: Artemis III Candidate Landing Region (NASA 2022 list). Topographic ridge extending from Connecting Ridge with expansive line-of-sight to Earth.

name: Artemis III: Malapert Massif
description: Artemis III Candidate Landing Region (NASA Oct 2024 selection). 5,000m elevated highland peak with near-continuous solar power and uninterrupted Earth line-of-sight.

name: Artemis III: Faustini Rim A
description: Artemis III Candidate Landing Region (NASA 2022 list). Elevated crater rim with persistent solar illumination adjacent to volatile-rich cold traps.

name: Artemis III: Haworth
description: Artemis III Candidate Landing Region (NASA Oct 2024 selection). Rim of Haworth crater hosting extensive cryogenic permanently shadowed regions (PSRs).

name: Artemis III: de Gerlache Rim 1
description: Artemis III Candidate Landing Region (NASA 2022 list). High rim terrace of de Gerlache crater overlooking permanently shadowed cold traps.

name: Artemis III: de Gerlache Rim 2
description: Artemis III Candidate Landing Region (NASA Oct 2024 selection). Stable plateau on de Gerlache rim with low terrain slopes suitable for surface habitation.

name: Artemis III: de Gerlache-Kocher Massif
description: Artemis III Candidate Landing Region (NASA 2022 list). Elevated highland massif between de Gerlache and Kocher with exceptional Earth visibility.

name: Artemis III: Leibnitz Beta Plateau
description: Artemis III Candidate Landing Region (NASA 2022 list). High-altitude smooth plateau on the rim of South Pole-Aitken basin.

name: Artemis III: Nobile Rim 1
description: Artemis III Candidate Landing Region (NASA Oct 2024 selection). Mountainous elevated ridge on Nobile crater rim near cryogenic permanently shadowed volatile traps.

name: Artemis III: Nobile Rim 2
description: Artemis III Candidate Landing Region (NASA Oct 2024 selection). Accessible terrace offering traverse routes into water-ice cold traps.

name: Artemis III: Amundsen Rim
description: Artemis III Candidate Landing Region (NASA 2022 list). Northern rim of Amundsen impact basin with diverse geochemical terrain.

name: Artemis III: Peak Near Cabeus B
description: Artemis III Candidate Landing Region (NASA Oct 2024 selection). Elevated peak near Cabeus B offering favorable solar illumination and line-of-sight communication.

name: Artemis III: Mons Mouton Plateau
description: Artemis III Candidate Landing Region (NASA Oct 2024 selection). Expansive high-elevation plateau adjacent to Mons Mouton with extensive level exploration terrain.

name: Artemis III: Mons Mouton
description: Artemis III Candidate Landing Region (NASA Oct 2024 selection). High-standing lunar mountain with persistent illumination periods near the South Pole.

name: Artemis III: Slater Plain
description: Artemis III Candidate Landing Region (NASA Oct 2024 selection). Low-slope inter-crater plain south of Slater crater offering safe surface operations.
